title: Thailand Hotel Revenue Management
thesis: Snowflake turns daily property-level data from a synthetic Thai hotel group into RevPAR, ADR, occupancy and booking KPIs, 7-day rate parity breach risk scores, rate sync lag anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables, with no guest records.

talking_points: RevPAR, ADR, room occupancy, bookings vs budget, bookings below the rate floor and confirmed rate parity breaches for 40 properties across 5 Thai cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to property-day rows.
The breach-driver chart shows which rate parity alerts turn into confirmed breaches and which are mostly cleared on review.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of revenue KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which properties should the distribution team look at first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each property for the probability of a confirmed rate parity breach in the next 7 days. It is an operational distribution score, not pricing advice.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags rate sync lag outliers per property, and the forecast projects daily new bookings for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Rate-loading audit compliance, channel parity audit coverage and average rate sync lag, from the curated tables.
The scatter compares audit compliance with confirmed breaches by property; it is a synthetic association, not evidence of cause.
The action memo is drafted by an LLM from the KPI, property, breach-driver and risk rows only, and needs human review.
tabs.call_out: From numbers to a reviewed action plan

transition.line: What are the rate shops showing right now?

talking_points: Live rate-shop events arrive from the native simulator (Snowflake only) or Firehose, S3 and Snowpipe (AWS build).
Events carry no guest identifiers: property, OTA price gap below the direct rate, rate sync lag and status.
The alert logs ALERT events with an SOP hint and emails the revenue management team.
tabs.call_out: Live distribution signals with an alert and email

transition.line: Can we ask the data directly?

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions through the semantic view and cites rate parity SOPs from Cortex Search.
Each answer shows the SQL it ran, so the figures can be checked.
Try: which 3 properties have the most confirmed rate parity breaches, and what SOP applies?
tabs.call_out: Grounded answers with SQL and SOP citations

talking_points: Both builds are shown, the current one first: Snowflake only, and AWS + Snowflake with Firehose, Bedrock and QuickSight.
Every flow in the diagrams is built by the scripts in the repository.
Alerts and tasks stay suspended between demos.
tabs.call_out: One platform for data, ML, AI and the app
